## Lecture outline (draft)

- **Problem:** The Burgers equation (the reference is the Hopf–Cole solution), the Sod shock tube (a Riemann problem); briefly, Taylor–Green vortices.
- **Tools:** conservative schemes, finite volumes, the Godunov scheme, limiters, the pseudo-spectral method.
- **Lead author:** Dmitry V. Naumov.
